```{popANI clustering and plotting}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(MKinfer)


instrain_compare <- read.table(instrainComparer_breadth0.05_new_genomeWide_compare.tsv, header = TRUE)

md2 <- read.table(gtdbtk_representative_taxonomy.txt, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")



# Prepare the compare_dist data frame by selecting relevant columns
compare_dist <- instrain_compare %>%
    select(genome, name1, name2, popANI)

# clean up names
compare_dist$genome <- gsub(".fa$", "", compare_dist$genome)
compare_dist$name1 <- gsub(".sorted.bam$", "", compare_dist$name1)
compare_dist$name2 <- gsub(".sorted.bam$", "", compare_dist$name2)

# Merge with taxonomy/cluster information from md2
compare_dist <- compare_dist %>%
    left_join(md2, by = c("genome" = "user_genome"))

# Split the data by secondary cluster from drep
cluster_list <- unique(compare_dist$secondary_cluster)
compare_dist_list <- split(compare_dist, compare_dist$secondary_cluster)

# Create pairwise distance matrices for each SGB
dist_matrices <- list()  

for (cluster in cluster_list) {
    dist_df <- compare_dist_list[[cluster]]
    
    
    unique_names <- unique(c(dist_df$name1, dist_df$name2))
    dist_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique_names), ncol = length(unique_names))
    rownames(dist_matrix) <- unique_names
    colnames(dist_matrix) <- unique_names
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(dist_df)) {
        name1 <- dist_df$name1[i]
        name2 <- dist_df$name2[i]
        popANI <- dist_df$popANI[i]
        
        dist_matrix[name1, name2] <- popANI
        dist_matrix[name2, name1] <- popANI
    }
    
    # Set self-comparison diagonal values to 1
    diag(dist_matrix) <- 1
    
    # Store the matrix in the list, named by its secondary cluster
    dist_matrices[[cluster]] <- dist_matrix
}

# --- Processing Matrices and Joining with Metadata ---

# This function converts each distance matrix to long format, removes self-comparisons,
# computes a dissimilarity measure (1 - popANI), and joins with mouse metadata. Also removes duplicates (e.g. if A vs B is compared, removes B vs. A)
set.seed(123)

process_and_join_matrices <- function(dist_matrices, mouse_md) {
  long_list <- lapply(names(dist_matrices), function(matrix_name) {
    dist_long <- dist_matrices[[matrix_name]] %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample_1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-sample_1, names_to = "sample_2", values_to = "popANI") %>%
      filter(sample_1 < sample_2) %>%   # <<< keeps unique unordered pairs only!!! THIS IS THE KEY DIFFERENCE
      left_join(mouse_md, by = c("sample_1" = "sample")) %>%
      rename(
        sex_1 = Sex, cage_1 = cage, group_1 = group, day_1 = day, diet_1 = diet,
        replicate_1 = replicate, mouse_1 = mouse, time_1 = time
      ) %>%
      left_join(mouse_md, by = c("sample_2" = "sample")) %>%
      rename(
        sex_2 = Sex, cage_2 = cage, group_2 = group, day_2 = day, diet_2 = diet,
        replicate_2 = replicate, mouse_2 = mouse, time_2 = time
      )
    dist_long
  })
  names(long_list) <- names(dist_matrices)
  long_list
}




# 1. Control Diet Clustering:

analyze_control_diet_clustering <- function(long_matrices, num_permutations = 999, timeout_seconds = 45) {
    results_list <- list()

    for (matrix_name in names(long_matrices)) {
        cat("Analyzing matrix:", matrix_name, "for control diet clustering\n")

        tryCatch({
            withTimeout({
                df <- long_matrices[[matrix_name]]

                
                df <- df %>%
                    mutate(control_diet_comp = case_when(
                        (diet_1 == "control_end" & diet_2 == "control_end") ~ "same",  # Both control_end
                        (diet_1 == "control_end" | diet_2 == "control_end") & !(diet_1 == "control_post" | diet_2 == "control_post") ~ "other",  # control_end vs. anything besides control_post
                        TRUE ~ NA_character_
                    )) %>%
                    filter(!is.na(control_diet_comp))  

                group_counts <- table(df$control_diet_comp)
                if (!("same" %in% names(group_counts)) || 
                    !("other" %in% names(group_counts)) ||
                    group_counts["same"] < 2 || group_counts["other"] < 2) {
                    cat("Skipping matrix:", matrix_name, "- insufficient data in one of the groups.\n")
                    next
                }

                
                x <- df$popANI[df$control_diet_comp == "same"]
                y <- df$popANI[df$control_diet_comp == "other"]

                if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) {
                    cat("Skipping matrix:", matrix_name, "- not enough observations in one group.\n")
                    next
                }

                
                perm_test <- perm.t.test(x = x, y = y, alternative = "greater", num_permutations = num_permutations)

                
                res <- tibble(
                    matrix_name = matrix_name,
                    comparison = "control_diet",
                    p_value_control = perm_test$p.value,
                    diff_means_control = perm_test$estimate[1],
                    se_control = perm_test$stderr,
                    conf_lower_control = perm_test$conf.int[1],
                    conf_upper_control = perm_test$conf.int[2],
                    test_statistic_control = perm_test$statistic
                )

                results_list[[matrix_name]] <- res
            }, timeout = timeout_seconds)
        }, TimeoutException = function(e) {
            cat("Matrix:", matrix_name, "took too long and was skipped.\n")
        })
    }

    results_table <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
        mutate(p_value_control_BH = p.adjust(p_value_control, method = "BH"))
    return(results_table)
}

# 2. Fat Diet Clustering:
analyze_fat_diet_clustering <- function(long_matrices, num_permutations = 999, timeout_seconds = 45) {
    results_list <- list()

    for (matrix_name in names(long_matrices)) {
        cat("Analyzing matrix:", matrix_name, "for fat diet clustering\n")

        tryCatch({
            withTimeout({
                df <- long_matrices[[matrix_name]]

                
                df <- df %>%
                    mutate(fat_diet_comp = case_when(
                        (diet_1 == "fat_end" & diet_2 == "fat_end") ~ "same",  # Both fat_end
                        (diet_1 == "fat_end" | diet_2 == "fat_end") & !(diet_1 == "fat_post" | diet_2 == "fat_post") ~ "other",  # fat_end vs. anything besides fat_post
                        TRUE ~ NA_character_
                    )) %>%
                    filter(!is.na(fat_diet_comp))  # Remove any rows not in the comparison

                group_counts <- table(df$fat_diet_comp)
                if (!("same" %in% names(group_counts)) || 
                    !("other" %in% names(group_counts)) ||
                    group_counts["same"] < 2 || group_counts["other"] < 2) {
                    cat("Skipping matrix:", matrix_name, "- insufficient data in one of the groups.\n")
                    next
                }

                
                x <- df$popANI[df$fat_diet_comp == "same"]
                y <- df$popANI[df$fat_diet_comp == "other"]

                if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) {
                    cat("Skipping matrix:", matrix_name, "- not enough observations in one group.\n")
                    next
                }

                
                perm_test <- perm.t.test(x = x, y = y, alternative = "greater", num_permutations = num_permutations)

                # Record results
                res <- tibble(
                    matrix_name = matrix_name,
                    comparison = "fat_diet",
                    p_value_fat = perm_test$p.value,
                    diff_means_fat = perm_test$estimate[1],
                    se_fat = perm_test$stderr,
                    conf_lower_fat = perm_test$conf.int[1],
                    conf_upper_fat = perm_test$conf.int[2],
                    test_statistic_fat = perm_test$statistic
                )

                results_list[[matrix_name]] <- res
            }, timeout = timeout_seconds)
        }, TimeoutException = function(e) {
            cat("Matrix:", matrix_name, "took too long and was skipped.\n")
        })
    }

    results_table <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
        mutate(p_value_fat_BH = p.adjust(p_value_fat, method = "BH"))
    return(results_table)
}

#run it

long_matrices <- process_and_join_matrices(dist_matrices, mouse_md)
perm_results_control <- analyze_control_diet_clustering(long_matrices, num_permutations = 999)
perm_results_fat <- analyze_fat_diet_clustering(long_matrices, num_permutations = 999)
perm_results_replicate <- analyze_replicate_clustering(long_matrices, num_permutations = 999)


# Remove comparison column and join by matrix_name
combined_results <- perm_results_control %>%
    select(-comparison) %>%  # Remove the comparison column
    full_join(
        perm_results_fat %>% select(-comparison),  # Remove comparison and join
        by = "matrix_name"
    ) %>%
    full_join(
        perm_results_replicate %>% select(-comparison),  # Remove comparison and join
        by = "matrix_name"
    )

# Append clustering type to column names
colnames(combined_results) <- gsub("_control$", "_control", colnames(combined_results))
colnames(combined_results) <- gsub("_fat$", "_fat", colnames(combined_results))
colnames(combined_results) <- gsub("_replicate$", "_replicate", colnames(combined_results))

# Add columns for significance flags
combined_results <- combined_results %>%
  mutate(
    significant_control = p_value_control_BH< 0.05,
    significant_fat = p_value_fat_BH < 0.05,
    significant_replicate = p_value_replicate_BH < 0.05
  )

# Count individual significant matrices
control_significant <- sum(combined_results$significant_control, na.rm = TRUE)
fat_significant <- sum(combined_results$significant_fat, na.rm = TRUE)



```
